title: Acceleration of cargo A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the initial acceleration of cargo A as 2 m/s² using Newton's second law with kinetic friction.

title: Total time for cargo A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time for cargo A to traverse the conveyor as 3.5 s, accounting for accelerated and constant velocity phases.

title: Force analysis for cargo B
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law to cargo B on the incline, resolving weight and friction for both acceleration phases.

title: Conveyor speed condition
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the condition for the conveyor speed v₀ to be less than 1 m/s to prevent cargo damage.

title: Kinematic application
description: Important: Correctly uses kinematic equations (v² = u² + 2as) to find displacements and the final speed of cargo B.

title: Two-phase motion recognition
description: Important: Identifies that both cargoes have a phase of acceleration to match the belt speed, followed by motion at constant relative speed.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for the frictional force on cargo B when its velocity relative to the belt changes direction.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the solution.
